Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Also check whether bands overlap anomalies' own patterns etc. Implement full solver and compare to all three demos.
def solve(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in I for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    lines=[(c,I[0][c]) for c in range(W) if len({I[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and I[0][c]!=bg]
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    def ray(r,c,dc):
        X=I[r][c]
        # flood toward dc until hitting a line or edge
        while True:
            cc=c+dc
            if not(0<=cc<W): return
            if any(lc==cc for lc,_ in lines):
                break
            if O[r][cc]!=X and not(O[r][cc]==0 and False):  # placeholder
                pass
            if I[r][cc]==bg: O[r][cc]=X
            else: return
        # now cc is a line col
        L=cc
        # segment: (r,L-1)=v,(r,L)=X,(r,L+1)=v ; then continue: next beyond = flood? no stop after one beyond cell painted v
        if L-1>=0 and 0<=L-1<W: O[r][L-1]=I[0][L]
        O[r][L]=X
        if L+1<W: O[r][L+1]=I[0][L]
        # band: rows r±1 get v at v-columns (L-1 and L+1 if they exist)
        for rr in (r-1,r+1):
            for cc_,val in ((L-1,I[0][L]),(L+1,I[0][L])):
                if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc_<W and I[rr][cc_]==bg: O[rr][cc_]=val
    anom=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg and not any(c==lc for lc,_ in lines)]
    for (r,c) in anom:
        ray(r,c,1); ray(r,c,-1)
    return O

def f(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    # separator rows: full-row colors; marker = isolated cell whose color isn't bg or sep
    seps=set()
    for i in range(h):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1: seps.add(g[i][0])
    bgs=cnt.most_common(2)
    bg, _ = bgs[0]
    # markers: cells not bg, not on separator rows, single cell
    marks=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w)
           if g[i][j]!=bg and not(i%h==0 and all(x!=g[i][j] for x in [1])) ]  # dummy
    return g

def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    dom=cnt.most_common(2)[0][0]
    sep_rows=[k for k in range(h) if len(set(g[k]))==1 and g[k][0]!=dom]
    seps={g[s][0] for s in sep_rows}
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    marks=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w)
           if g[i][j]!=dom and g[i][j] not in seps]
    for mi,mj,k in marks:
        ups=[s for s in sep_rows if s<mi]
        dns=[s for s in sep_rows if s>mi]
        for s in ([max(ups)] if ups else [])+([min(dns)] if dns else []):
            # fill between
            rng=range(min(mi,s)+1,max(mi,s))
            for t in rng:
                if g[t][mj]==dom: out[t][mj]=k
            out[s][mj]=k
            sc=g[s][0]
            for di in (-1,0,1):
                for dj in (-1,0,1):
                    if 0<=s+di<h and 0<=mj+dj<w and (abs(di)+abs(dj)!=1):
                        out[s+di][mj+dj]=sc
    return out
